Actual transparent background and transparent holes inside glasses, NO people, skin, heads, hair or mannequins, no labels, no grid lines, generous 15% transparent gutters. Row1 left to right: (1) black rounded sunglasses with opaque dark lenses; (2) thin black rectangular eyeglasses with completely transparent lenses; (3) thin round gold wire eyeglasses with completely transparent lenses; (4) rimless eyeglasses with subtle glass edge, transparent lenses and tiny silver bridge. Row2: (1) soft black French artist beret; (2) soft beige newsboy flat cap with small brim; (3) natural straw sunhat with woven texture and black ribbon; (4) charcoal ribbed beanie. Max resolution square. These will be cropped into 12 tiles and mapped to facial landmarks. Keep glasses straight and frontal, no extreme perspective.

Use reference for EXACT Captain Beer identity. Create an animation sprite atlas on REAL TRANSPARENT background, 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, maximum resolution. The SAME matte clay Captain Beer in every cell: red cap, long chunky black hair and full long beard, NO eyes NO nose NO mouth, bare round peach ivory belly with tiny X bellybutton, red shorts, mitten hands without fingers, bare feet. Full body from hat to soles, identical scale and centered in each tile, at least 10% clear margins, neutral orthographic three-quarter view facing RIGHT, no ground scene or text. Row1 is four sequential WALK CYCLE keyframes: left leg long forward right leg back, passing pose, right leg long forward left leg back, opposite passing pose. Arms swing naturally with legs, hat/hair/body constant. Row2 is four consecutive looking at PAPER MAP animation keyframes: taking folded map out, unfolding wide map in both hands at belly height, looking down at map, holding map and slightly tilting head. Row3 is four consecutive TELESCOPE animation keyframes: raising small brass telescope, holding it up to blank face looking right, pointing telescope slightly upward, lowering it. All twelve match exact supplied character identity, 3D clay volume, no facial features. Do NOT draw background, cell borders, multiple figures per cell, captions, flag in these cells.
